paypal.note: Real supplier sandbox invoice, buyer checkout, signed webhook and authoritative reconciliation; mismatch and replay checks.

ai.note: Redacted corpus report, free-tier/card status, quotas, privacy controls, expiry and gateway topology if used.

hosting.note: Hosted auth, role/tenant isolation, private bucket, migration and deletion recovery; judging availability and verified credit expiry.

naming.note: Exact/fuzzy registry check, domain result and any material risk acknowledged. No domain purchase required.

submission.note: Public MIT repo, functional judge instructions or URL, public YouTube video under 180 seconds, truthful runtime/development AI disclosures.
